A place for the whole picture

Plan the work.
Leave room for life.

Keep a deadline separate from a planned day. See fixed events alongside tasks. Record what you actually worked on.

Explore the 54-feature catalogue ↗

01

Give every task a place.

Categories, two-level projects, subtasks, named checklist groups, task dependencies, templates, recurring series with progressive step plans, Quick Search, and saved views.

02

See your day in context.

Day, Week, and Month time-grids on Windows with cursor-anchored zoom and drag-resize, plus touch agendas on Android. Preview deterministic Smart Reschedule plans before applying.

03

Make progress visible.

Track habits and quantitative milestones, run Stopwatch, Countdown, or Pomodoro focus timers, attach files offline or via Android's Shared Inbox, and inspect local reports.

04

Keep it close. Make it yours.

Independent Explorer-hosted Windows Tasks & Calendar widgets and Android launcher widgets keep your day in sight. Customize palettes, surface transparency, and keyboard shortcuts.

Your plans are personal

Local by default.
Recovery by design.

Todorbit works offline without accounts or analytics. Your planner lives in a local SQLite database with forward-only schema migrations, local snapshots, reviewed restore flows, and an optional privacy PIN.

Read the privacy policy ↗

A backup before you restore.

Reviewed database replacement automatically preserves a Before Restore snapshot. Export verified SQLite backups before moving portable builds or upgrading.

Settings can travel separately.

Export or selectively import supported personalization—including themes, hotkey presets, navigation order, and widget layouts—without touching database records or credentials.

Google Drive · experimental backup & sync

Experimental builds include optional AES-256-GCM Google Drive snapshot backups and incremental cross-device Sync (`Standard Sync` readable JSON default or `Private Encrypted Sync` wrapped with Argon2id) using hidden drive.appdata storage.

Google branding verification and full public OAuth policy compliance remain unresolved, so no Google approval or universal account compatibility is claimed. Keep verified local backups before testing Sync.

Windows x64

Windows 11 is the primary test platform. Windows 10 acceptance is limited; packages are unsigned.

Windows installer ↓ Portable ZIP ↓

Extract the full portable ZIP together (`Todorbit.exe`, `TodorbitWidget.exe`, DLLs, `data/`). Moving a portable folder selects a separate profile.

Android 8.0+

Production-signed prerelease APK for ARM64 and x86-64 devices (API 26+).

Android APK ↓

Upgrades require a build signed with the same publisher key. GitHub builds verify AOSP signatures natively before launching Android's installer.
